aries.summary: 2027 asks Aries to build a steadier, more mature version of yourself while Jupiter first brings romance and creative joy, then shifts your focus to daily routines. Friendships and fresh ideas keep the year lively.
aries.overview:
The deepest theme of 2027 is the work of Saturn and Neptune, both travelling through Aries all year. Saturn is the planet of structure and responsibility, and Neptune is the planet of imagination and blurred edges. Together they touch your sense of self, your body and the impression you make. You may feel pushed to take yourself more seriously, set firmer standards and decide who you really want to be, while also noticing that your image is softer and less certain than usual. Patience suits you better than speed here, which is not always easy for a sign that likes to charge ahead.

Jupiter, the planet of growth and luck, moves through two areas this year. Until July 25 it is in Leo, lighting up love affairs, fun, creativity and anything you do for pure enjoyment. From July 26 it moves into Virgo, and the focus turns to daily work, routines and health habits. The first half invites you to play and express yourself. The second half rewards small, steady improvements in how you spend your days.

In the background, Pluto stays in Aquarius, slowly transforming your friendships, groups and long-term hopes. Some circles may fade while others become more meaningful. Uranus, the planet of surprise, continues through Gemini and keeps conversations, short trips and your dealings with siblings and neighbours unpredictable in a stimulating way. Expect news, sudden messages and new ways of communicating. None of this is fixed, but these are the currents you can work with.
aries.love:
The first seven months are the warmest for romance. Jupiter in Leo, the sign that rules flirting, dates and joyful self-expression, favours playfulness, and Mars, your ruling planet, also passes through Leo from February 22 to May 14. If you are single, you may meet someone through a hobby, a creative project or a night out. If you are in a relationship, shared fun and spontaneous plans can bring back a spark.

Saturn in Aries can make you more cautious about showing vulnerability, so notice if you are guarding yourself more than you need to. Honesty about what you want will serve you better than testing people.

From mid July to early September, Mars in Libra, your opposite sign, puts partnerships under the spotlight. Disagreements are possible, but so is real clarity about what each of you needs. Friends may also play a bigger part in your love life, since Pluto in Aquarius shapes your social circle. A partner may come from there, or you may find that your friendships ask for more attention.
aries.work:
Work takes a different tone after Jupiter enters Virgo on July 26. Before that, your career may benefit from creative thinking and a willingness to be seen, and projects that let you show personality could get noticed. Afterwards, the focus moves to the daily machinery of your job: schedules, systems, teamwork and the habits that keep you effective. This is a good time to streamline a process, learn a practical skill or ask for clearer responsibilities.

Saturn in Aries asks you to lead with more discipline. Plans you commit to in 2027 may feel heavy at times, yet they can also earn lasting respect. Mars in Capricorn from November 26 turns your energy toward career and long-term goals, a good moment to take initiative on something you have prepared.

Uranus in Gemini may bring unexpected emails, calls or offers. Check details carefully, especially during the Mercury retrograde from June 11 to July 4, when communication can tangle and old plans may need a second look.
aries.money: Money matters tend to be steadier when you plan ahead, and Saturn encourages that. The first half of the year may tempt you to spend on fun, outings and gifts, so a simple budget can help you enjoy these things without strain. After July, Jupiter in Virgo favours practical habits such as tracking expenses and trimming what you do not use. Mars in Scorpio from September 2 to October 15 highlights shared money, such as joint accounts, loans or debts. Mercury retrograde from October 8 to October 28 is a good reason to reread any agreements before committing. These are general tendencies, not financial advice.
aries.growth:
This year invites you to grow by slowing down, which is a real stretch for Aries. Saturn and Neptune in your sign may leave you wondering who you are becoming. Instead of forcing an answer, try small experiments: a new style, a different way of speaking up, a boundary you have never set. Neptune also suggests that quiet time, music, walks or journaling can clear your head.

Once Jupiter moves into Virgo, routines become the main tool for wellbeing. Regular sleep, balanced meals and movement you actually enjoy tend to matter more than dramatic resolutions. Mercury retrograde from February 10 to March 3 is a natural time for rest and reflection, so you might protect some solitude then. Notice where your energy goes, and let that guide what you keep.
aries.dates:
February 6: annular solar eclipse in Aquarius, a turning point for friendships and hopes for the future. A solar eclipse is a new moon that blocks the Sun and often marks a fresh start.

February 10 to March 3: Mercury retrograde, when the planet of communication appears to move backwards, favouring rest and review. February 20 brings a lunar eclipse in Virgo, touching work routines.

February 22 to May 14: Mars in Leo, a lively stretch for romance and creativity.

June 11 to July 4: Mercury retrograde, centred on home and family. July 18: lunar eclipse in Capricorn, about career.

July 15 to September 1: Mars in Libra, focusing on partnerships.

July 26: Jupiter enters Virgo. August 2: total solar eclipse in Leo, a strong moment for love and creativity. August 17: lunar eclipse in Aquarius.

October 8 to October 28: Mercury retrograde, on shared money and intimacy. November 26: Mars enters Capricorn.
aries.advice: Let 2027 teach you that steady effort can be as powerful as a fast start. Enjoy the warmth of the first half of the year, then use the second half to build habits that you can keep.

faq.q: Will 2027 be a good year for love for Aries?
faq.a: It has strong potential, especially until late July, when Jupiter in Leo favours romance, fun and creative connection. Mars in Leo from February 22 to May 14 adds energy to dating. From mid July, Mars in Libra turns attention to how you relate one to one.

faq.q: What will money look like for Aries in 2027?
faq.a: The year leans toward practical, careful handling of money, with Saturn encouraging planning. Spending on enjoyment may be tempting early on, while Jupiter in Virgo later favours organised habits. Take extra care with shared finances between September 2 and October 28.

faq.q: What are the best months for Aries in 2027?
faq.a: March to mid May looks lively for romance and creativity, with Mars and Jupiter both in Leo. August is also notable, as the total solar eclipse on August 2 can open a new chapter in love or self-expression. Late November and December suit career goals, once Mars enters Capricorn on November 26.

taurus.summary: Taurus in 2027 is a year of quiet inner work and a gradual shift in what you value. Home and family come first, then from late July more romance, play and creativity arrive, while your career slowly rebuilds.
taurus.overview:
The deepest tone of 2027 comes from Saturn (the planet of structure and patience) and Neptune (the planet of dreams and blur). Both spend the whole year in Aries, the part of your chart tied to rest, solitude and what happens behind the scenes. Expect a pull toward quieter hours, private reflection and sorting out worries you have carried silently. Neptune can make things hazy, so double-check details and listen to your tiredness. Saturn asks you to build healthier boundaries around your energy.

Two other slow planets shape your practical life. Uranus, the planet of surprise, stays in Gemini and keeps stirring your money, possessions and self-worth. You may see unexpected ideas about earning, or a new sense of what is truly worth your resources. Pluto, the planet of deep transformation, continues through Aquarius and works on your career, reputation and goals. This is slow, steady reconstruction of what you want to be known for, not a sudden overhaul.

Jupiter, the planet of growth and generosity, brings the warmest colour. Until July 25 it moves through Leo, lighting up home, family and roots, so living space, relatives and your sense of belonging get attention. From July 26 it enters Virgo, shifting the spotlight to love affairs, fun, creativity and children. That second half of the year can feel lighter, more playful and more openhearted than the first. A total solar eclipse in Leo on August 2 marks the turning point.
taurus.love:
Romance in 2027 has two moods. In the first half, Jupiter in Leo keeps your heart close to home, so love tends to grow through shared meals, family time and making your space feel safe. Mars passes through Virgo from January 1 to February 21 and again from May 15 to July 14, bringing bursts of flirtation, dates and playful energy. From July 26, Jupiter in Virgo opens a more joyful chapter for love affairs, creativity and, if you have them, time with children. New attraction or a rekindled spark is quite possible. Venus, your ruling planet, loves comfort, so slow, sensual pleasures suit you best.

Partnership themes peak from September 2 to October 15, when Mars moves through Scorpio, your opposite sign. Conversations can get intense, and Mercury retrograde from October 8 to 28 invites you to revisit old topics with patience rather than start new debates.
taurus.work:
Pluto in Aquarius keeps your career and reputation in a long process of renewal. You may feel a growing wish for work that matches your goals rather than simply paying the bills. The annular solar eclipse on February 6 and the lunar eclipse on August 17, both in Aquarius, can highlight professional questions and bring decisions or news that change your direction a little.

Saturn in Aries suggests that much of your best work happens out of sight: planning, learning, finishing unglamorous tasks. Mercury retrograde from February 10 to March 3 touches friends, groups and hopes, so it is a good time to review who you network with and what you truly want. From July 15 to September 1, Mars in Libra turns attention to daily routines. Streamlining your schedule and being steady with your habits can pay off then. As a fixed sign, your persistence is your strength.
taurus.money: Uranus in Gemini keeps money a lively topic all year. Income or spending habits may change in ways you did not plan, and you may rethink what you value and what you feel you deserve. As a Taurus, you like stability, so small experiments are likely to suit you better than big leaps. Jupiter in Leo early in the year can bring spending on home and family, and Jupiter in Virgo later can bring spending on pleasure and creative projects. From October 16 to November 25, Mars in Sagittarius draws attention to shared money and deep change, so clear talks about joint resources may matter.
taurus.growth:
With Saturn and Neptune both in Aries, 2027 invites you to slow down and listen inward. Rest is not a reward here but a skill to practise. Quiet routines such as walks, journaling, time in nature or simply unplugged evenings can help you notice what you truly feel. Neptune can blur your sense of direction, so writing things down may help you tell intuition from worry.

Uranus in Gemini asks you to loosen rigid ideas about your worth. You are more than what you earn or own. As Jupiter enters Virgo in late July, make room for play and creative hobbies without needing them to be productive. Your Taurus gift for patience grows when you allow joy to be part of the plan.
taurus.dates:
February 6 brings an annular solar eclipse in Aquarius, a turning point for career and goals. Mercury is retrograde (it seems to move backward, a time to review rather than start) from February 10 to March 3, touching friends and hopes. The lunar eclipse on February 20 in Virgo highlights romance and creativity. Mars is in Leo from February 22 to May 14, which energises home matters.

Mercury retrogrades again from June 11 to July 4, affecting talks, short trips and siblings or neighbours. The lunar eclipse on July 18 in Capricorn touches travel, study and beliefs. Jupiter moves into Virgo on July 26, opening your joyful, creative chapter. The total solar eclipse on August 2 in Leo centres on home and family, followed by the August 17 lunar eclipse in Aquarius for career. Mars in Scorpio from September 2 to October 15 and Mercury retrograde from October 8 to 28 focus on close partnerships.
taurus.advice: Give yourself permission to work quietly and rest well, because the foundations you build behind the scenes this year support the brighter chapter that begins in late July. Choose steady, small steps over dramatic moves, and let pleasure be part of your routine.

faq.q: Will 2027 be a good year for love for Taurus?
faq.a: It can be, especially after July 26, when Jupiter enters Virgo and favours romance, fun and creativity. Before that, love tends to grow through home life and family closeness. Partnership talks become more intense from September 2 to October 15.

faq.q: What does 2027 mean for Taurus money?
faq.a: Uranus in Gemini keeps money and self-worth in motion all year, so unexpected ideas or changes in how you earn and spend are possible. Steady, modest experiments often suit Taurus better than big risks. Shared money matters come into focus from October 16 to November 25.

faq.q: What are the luckiest months for Taurus in 2027?
faq.a: The period after Jupiter, the planet of good fortune, enters Virgo on July 26 looks the most open and enjoyable, especially for love and creative projects. Spring is also warm for home and family while Mars is in Leo from February 22 to May 14. Luck here means opportunity, so it still rewards your effort.

gemini.summary: Gemini in 2027 is a year of rethinking friendships and hopes, while Uranus keeps reshaping how you present yourself. Jupiter moves from lively talk and travel to home and family in late July, which gives the year two distinct halves.
gemini.overview:
The biggest theme of 2027 is your circle of friends, groups and long term hopes. Saturn, the planet of structure and testing, and Neptune, the planet of dreams and blur, both stay in Aries all year. Together they ask which wishes are real and which friendships truly hold you up. Expect some sorting out: a group may fade, a hope may need a firmer plan, and a vague wish may become something you can actually work on. Take your time before committing to causes or people who sound better than they feel.

The second theme is you. Uranus, the planet of surprise and change, remains in your own sign, so your look, your habits and the way you come across keep evolving. You may feel restless with old labels. Small experiments, like a new style, a different routine or a fresh way of speaking up, suit you better than a dramatic overnight reinvention.

Jupiter, the planet of growth, divides the year. Until July 25 it moves through Leo, which favours conversations, writing, learning, short trips and good contact with siblings or neighbours. From July 26 it travels through Virgo, turning attention to home, family and your roots. A move, a renovation or a warmer family rhythm may take centre stage. Behind all this, Pluto in Aquarius continues its slow work on your beliefs and your wider view of life, inviting you to study, travel or rethink what you stand for.
gemini.love:
Romance in 2027 tends to grow through conversation. With Jupiter in Leo until July 25, flirting, messaging and easy laughter come naturally, and a chat that starts casually could become something more. If you are attached, curious talks about what each of you hopes for can bring you closer. Saturn in Aries may make you more selective about the friends who introduce you to people, so quality matters more than quantity.

The warmest stretch for fun and affection is when Mars, the planet of drive and desire, passes through Libra from July 15 to September 1. Dates, creative projects and playful time with children or younger people may feel especially rewarding. From October 16 to November 25 Mars in Sagittarius, your opposite sign, puts close one to one bonds in focus. Honest talk helps, and so does patience when opinions differ. From late July Jupiter in Virgo may also make home life a place where love feels steadier, so shared routines and cosy evenings are worth nurturing.
gemini.work:
Your working year starts with a communicative tone. While Jupiter is in Leo, pitching ideas, writing, teaching, networking and short work trips are likely to bring useful openings. Mars in Leo from February 22 to May 14 adds energy to these efforts, so it is a good window to speak up and get projects moving. Be careful with hasty words, though, because pace can turn into pushiness.

Mercury, your ruling planet, turns retrograde (appears to move backward, a time for review) from February 10 to March 3, touching career and goals. Use it to revisit plans rather than launch new ones. Another review comes from October 8 to October 28, when daily routines are the focus. Mars in Scorpio from September 2 to October 15 can give you stamina for demanding tasks. In the second half of the year, working from home or involving family in your plans may feel natural. Saturn in Aries rewards teamwork that has clear rules and roles.
gemini.money: Money matters tend to ask for review rather than bold moves. Mercury retrograde from June 11 to July 4 touches money, possessions and self-worth, so it is a sensible time to check subscriptions, recheck figures and think about what you value before big purchases. The lunar eclipse on July 18 highlights shared money and joint resources, which may bring useful clarity about who contributes what. From late July, Jupiter in Virgo may bring spending ideas around the home, such as repairs or comfort upgrades. Plan these steadily. This is general reflection, not financial advice.
gemini.growth:
Uranus in your sign makes self-discovery a constant background hum this year. You may notice a need for more freedom, variety and room to try new versions of yourself. Give that need a healthy outlet: a class, a change of scenery, a new hobby or a different way of dressing. Because your mind often runs fast, steady habits help, such as regular sleep, time outdoors and quiet moments without a screen.

Neptune in Aries may blur the line between hope and fantasy, so writing down your wishes and sorting them into small steps can keep you grounded. Pluto in Aquarius encourages deeper study and questioning of your beliefs. Reading, travelling or talking with people who see life differently can widen your view without forcing you to change everything at once.
gemini.dates:
The year opens with eclipses, which are turning points that often bring a theme to a head. The annular solar eclipse on February 6 in Aquarius touches travel, study and beliefs. Mercury retrograde runs from February 10 to March 3, and the lunar eclipse on February 20 in Virgo brings home and family into view. Mars in Leo from February 22 to May 14 energises conversations and short trips.

Mercury retrogrades again from June 11 to July 4, a good time to review money and self-worth. The lunar eclipse on July 18 in Capricorn highlights shared money. On July 26 Jupiter enters Virgo and shifts your focus to home and family. The total solar eclipse on August 2 in Leo lights up talks and sibling or neighbour matters, and the lunar eclipse on August 17 in Aquarius returns to beliefs and the big picture. Mars in Libra from July 15 to September 1 favours romance and creativity. The last Mercury retrograde runs from October 8 to October 28, and Mars in Sagittarius from October 16 to November 25 focuses on partnerships.
gemini.advice: Let your curiosity lead, but give your friendships and hopes the same honest check you would give a good idea. Keep experimenting with who you are, and let home become a place that supports you in the second half of the year.

faq.q: Is 2027 a good year for love for Gemini?
faq.a: It can be, especially through conversation and shared fun. Jupiter in Leo until July 25 favours easy, open contact, and Mars in Libra from July 15 to September 1 adds warmth and playfulness. These are tendencies, so your own choices count most.

faq.q: What will money look like for Gemini in 2027?
faq.a: The tone is review and steady planning rather than big risks. Mercury retrograde from June 11 to July 4 is a good time to look over your finances and what you value. After July 26, Jupiter in Virgo may turn spending toward the home.

faq.q: What are the best months for Gemini in 2027?
faq.a: Late February to mid May suits talking, writing and moving projects forward, with Mars and Jupiter both in Leo. Mid July to the start of September is lovely for romance and creativity, and the months after July 26 favour home and family. Luck looks strongest early in the year for communication and later for domestic matters.

cancer.summary: In 2027 Jupiter lifts your sense of worth and income in Leo until late July, then turns your attention to conversations and short trips. Saturn and Neptune keep your career and public goals under steady, serious review all year.
cancer.overview:
The loudest theme of 2027 is your career and reputation. Saturn, the planet of structure and long-term effort, and Neptune, the planet of dreams and blurred edges, both spend the whole year in Aries, the part of your chart tied to public life and goals. Saturn asks you to build something real, one reliable step at a time. Neptune can make the target feel foggy, so you may need to check whether the goal you are chasing is truly yours or just inherited from someone else's expectations. Pairing the two means a practical plan and an honest daydream can work together.

Jupiter, the planet of growth and generosity, is the second big influence. Until July 25 it moves through Leo, the area of money, possessions and self-worth, which can make this a good stretch for noticing what you are worth and what you want to earn or own. From July 26 it enters Virgo, shifting the focus to conversations, short trips, siblings and neighbours. Expect more messages, more local movement and more chances to be heard.

Underneath, two slower currents run all year. Pluto in Aquarius keeps working on shared money, intimacy and deep change, so topics like joint finances, trust and what you truly share with others may keep resurfacing. Uranus in Gemini touches rest, solitude and what happens behind the scenes. It can bring sudden insights during quiet hours, along with a restless need to break old habits of overgiving. Your ruler, the Moon, makes you sensitive to all of this, so protecting some private time matters.
cancer.love: Romance in 2027 tends to grow through honesty rather than grand gestures. Pluto in Aquarius keeps asking how much you really let another person in. If you are partnered, conversations about trust, shared responsibilities and emotional needs may feel deeper than usual, and they can bring you closer when you stay curious instead of defensive. If you are single, the most promising stretch for fun, flirting and creative play is from September 2 to October 15, when Mars, the planet of drive, moves through Scorpio, your area of love affairs and enjoyment. Mercury, the planet of communication, turns retrograde (appears to move backward) from October 8 to 28 in that same area, so old feelings or past partners may resurface for review. Treat that as a time to understand your patterns, not to rush into commitments. Late in the year Mars enters Capricorn, your opposite sign, which highlights one-to-one partnerships and can make you more direct about what you need.
cancer.work: Saturn in Aries makes work the main stage this year. You may be given more responsibility, or you may feel a pull to prove that your efforts deserve recognition. Progress is likely to come slowly but solidly, so steady habits count for more than quick wins. Neptune in the same area can blur your sense of direction at times, which makes it wise to put agreements, roles and expectations in clear words. From July 26, Jupiter in Virgo brings more emphasis on communication, so presentations, emails, networking and short work trips may help your visibility. Mars in Sagittarius from October 16 to November 25 turns attention to daily routines, which is a good time to tidy up your workflow. Mercury retrograde from February 10 to March 3 touches study and the big picture, so it suits revising plans rather than launching new ones.
cancer.money: Jupiter in Leo until July 25 puts your income, belongings and self-worth in a more generous light. You may feel more confident asking for fair pay or recognising your skills. Mars in Leo from February 22 to May 14 adds energy to that area, which can encourage action but also impulse spending, so pausing before big purchases may serve you. The total solar eclipse on August 2 in Leo is a turning point for how you value yourself and what you own. Pluto in Aquarius keeps shared money, debts and joint resources in view all year, so clear conversations with partners or family about who contributes what can bring relief.
cancer.growth: As a Cancer, you tend to take care of everyone else first. Uranus in Gemini, in your area of rest and solitude, suggests that 2027 may reward quiet time away from demands. Sudden ideas or changes of mood can arrive when you are alone, so a notebook or a regular slow evening can help you catch them. Jupiter in Leo may strengthen your sense of what you deserve, and Jupiter in Virgo later in the year may help you put feelings into words. Mercury retrograde from June 11 to July 4 passes through Cancer and Gemini, which relates to self-image and how you come across. Use it to review how you present yourself and which habits no longer fit. Sleep, gentle movement and honest talks with trusted people are simple supports for your emotional balance.

cancer.advice: Let 2027 teach you to build slowly and speak plainly. Put steady effort into your career goals, say what you need in your close relationships, and protect enough quiet time that your instincts can keep guiding you.

faq.q: Will 2027 be a good year for love for Cancer?
faq.a: It can be, especially if you value depth over excitement. Pluto in Aquarius encourages honest talks about trust all year, and the most playful romantic stretch is from September 2 to October 15 while Mars is in Scorpio. Mercury retrograde from October 8 to 28 suits reflection more than big decisions.

faq.q: What does 2027 look like for Cancer's money?
faq.a: Jupiter in Leo until July 25 tends to support your confidence about income and what you own. The total solar eclipse on August 2 may mark a shift in how you value yourself. Shared money stays a theme all year, so open talks with partners or family may help.

faq.q: Which are the best months for Cancer in 2027, and how is luck?
faq.a: Spring, from late February to mid May, may feel productive for money matters with Mars in Leo, and the period from late July onward may bring helpful conversations as Jupiter enters Virgo. Luck tends to favour steady effort more than sudden windfalls, especially with Saturn in your career area all year.

leo.summary: 2027 opens with Jupiter, the planet of growth, still in your sign, so the first half favours confidence and visibility. After late July the focus moves to money and self-worth, while Saturn and Neptune push you to rethink your wider goals.
leo.overview:
The biggest theme of 2027 is Jupiter, the planet of growth and opportunity, travelling through Leo until July 25. It only visits your sign about every twelve years, and it touches your self-image, your energy and the way people see you. Expect doors to open when you show up as yourself. The total solar eclipse in Leo on August 2 acts like a reset button for this chapter: a moment to decide who you want to be next. From July 26, Jupiter moves into Virgo and turns your attention to income, possessions and what you believe you are worth.

The second theme runs all year in the background. Saturn (the planet of structure and discipline) and Neptune (the planet of dreams and blurred edges) both sit in Aries, your area of travel, study, beliefs and the big picture. Saturn asks you to commit to a plan, a course or a worldview with real effort behind it. Neptune can make that picture hazy or idealistic, so it helps to test big ideas against practical facts before you follow them.

Two more slow planets shape the mood. Pluto in Aquarius, directly opposite your sign, keeps working on close one-to-one relationships, slowly changing the balance of power and honesty in them. Uranus in Gemini, the planet of surprise, stirs up your friendships, groups and hopes for the future. Some circles may fade while unexpected people arrive. Together, these influences suggest a year of visible growth on the surface and quiet renegotiation underneath.
leo.love:
Pluto in Aquarius continues to work on your closest partnerships, and the annular solar eclipse on February 6 and the lunar eclipse on August 17 both land in that area. An eclipse is a turning point, a moment when something hidden comes to light. In practice, you may see more clearly what you need from a partner and what you are no longer willing to carry quietly. Honest conversations can deepen a bond if you speak without trying to win.

With Jupiter in your sign until July, you tend to be warmer and more magnetic, which can draw new people toward you. Single Leos may find that being relaxed and generous works better than trying to impress. Mars in Leo from February 22 to May 14 adds boldness to flirting and initiative. Later, Mars in Sagittarius from October 16 to November 25 lights up romance, fun and creativity, a good stretch for dates, shared adventures and playful time with children. Uranus in Gemini may also bring love interests through friends or groups.
leo.work:
Jupiter in Leo until July 25 can help you be noticed. You may find it easier to speak up, lead a project or ask for a role that fits your talents. Mars in Leo, from February 22 to May 14, adds drive, so spring is a strong time to start things that need energy. Be careful not to steamroll colleagues, as confidence works best when others feel included.

Saturn in Aries rewards serious study, training or planning toward a long-term goal. If you have thought about a qualification, a move abroad or a change of field, this is a year to build the foundation step by step. Neptune in the same area means some ideas will sound better than they are, so check details before committing.

The lunar eclipse on July 18 touches your daily work and routines, a hint to adjust how your days are organised. Mars in Capricorn from November 26 brings a push to tidy habits and finish tasks before year end. Uranus may shake up team dynamics through friends or networks.
leo.money: Money moves to the foreground in the second half of the year. Jupiter enters Virgo on July 26, and it can expand your sense of what is possible with income and possessions. That works best when paired with realism, so it is a good time to look closely at what you value and spend on. Mars in Virgo, from January 1 to February 21 and again May 15 to July 14, makes you more active around earning and spending. The lunar eclipse on February 20 may reveal where money habits no longer suit you. Shared finances deserve extra care during the Mercury retrograde from February 10 to March 3.
leo.growth:
This year invites you to grow in two directions. First comes visibility: with Jupiter in your sign, you are encouraged to take up space, try something that makes you proud and let people see more of you. The total solar eclipse on August 2 is a natural moment to set an intention about the person you are becoming.

Second comes depth. Saturn and Neptune in Aries ask you to look at your beliefs and decide which ones are truly yours. Writing, studying or travelling can help you sort inspiration from wishful thinking. The Mercury retrograde from June 11 to July 4 falls in your area of rest and solitude, so quiet time, sleep and unplugging may do you more good than extra activity. Mars in Capricorn at year end supports steady routines. Small habits repeated daily tend to matter more than big resolutions.
leo.dates:
Mercury retrograde means Mercury appears to move backward in the sky, a good time to review rather than begin. The first one runs from February 10 to March 3 and touches shared money and intimacy. The second, from June 11 to July 4, concerns rest and behind the scenes matters. The third, from October 8 to 28, centres on home and family.

Eclipses mark turning points. The solar eclipse on February 6 and the lunar eclipse on August 17 affect partnerships. The lunar eclipse on February 20 touches money and self-worth, and the one on July 18 touches daily work and routines. The most important is the total solar eclipse in Leo on August 2.

Jupiter leaves Leo and enters Virgo on July 26. Mars is in Leo from February 22 to May 14, a high energy stretch for you, and in Sagittarius from October 16 to November 25, favouring romance and creativity.
leo.advice: Use the confidence of Jupiter in your sign early in the year, then turn it into something lasting before the August eclipse. Let your closest relationships and your beliefs be tested honestly, and keep what still feels true.

faq.q: Will 2027 be a good year for love for Leo?

aquarius.overview:
The warmest theme of 2027 is partnership. Jupiter, the planet of growth and opportunity, spends the first seven months in Leo, the sign opposite yours, and it lights up your close one-to-one relationships: romantic, business or deeply personal. Doors may open through other people, and honest conversations tend to go further than usual. On July 26 Jupiter moves into Virgo and the focus shifts to shared money, intimacy and the kind of trust that changes you. Joint plans, loans, inheritances and emotional openness all come into view, so the second half of the year asks for clarity about what you share and what you keep.

Underneath this runs a more demanding thread. Saturn, the planet of structure and responsibility, and Neptune, the planet of dreams and blur, both sit in Aries all year. Aries rules your everyday communication: talks, messages, short trips, siblings and neighbours. Saturn asks you to be precise and to keep your word, while Neptune can make details slippery. Write things down, confirm plans, and listen for what people mean as well as what they say. It is a good year to learn to explain your ideas in simpler terms.

Two slower currents round out the picture. Uranus in Gemini, the planet of surprises, keeps stirring your love life, creativity and sense of fun, so expect sudden inspirations, unusual attractions and projects that refuse to stay predictable. Meanwhile Pluto, the planet of deep transformation, continues its long stay in Aquarius. It touches your identity and image, and it rewards you for dropping habits that no longer fit. Change is gradual here, more like a slow renovation than a sudden move.
aquarius.love: Jupiter in Leo until July 25 puts the spotlight on your closest bond. If you are in a relationship, this can be a generous stretch for deepening commitment, planning together and saying things that have waited too long. If you are single, meeting someone through work, friends or a shared interest looks more likely than a purely random encounter, and Mars in Leo from February 22 to May 14 adds energy and directness. Uranus in Gemini keeps romance lively and a little unpredictable. You may be drawn to someone who surprises you, or you may want more room to play and experiment together. From late July, Jupiter in Virgo shifts the theme to intimacy and trust. Talk openly about money, boundaries and what each of you needs, because honesty will matter more than charm. The total solar eclipse on August 2 can highlight a turning point in a partnership, which is often a moment of clarity rather than drama.
aquarius.work: Saturn in Aries makes your daily communication a professional skill this year. Emails, pitches, meetings and short work trips need care, and people will notice whether you are reliable. Clear wording and follow-through can earn you real credibility. Partnerships are also useful at work. Until late July, Jupiter in Leo favours collaborations, negotiations and clients who see your value. After that, shared resources, budgets and joint ventures take more attention. Your career gets its strongest push when Mars moves through Scorpio from September 2 to October 15, a good window for visible effort and bold goals. Mercury turns retrograde (an apparent backward drift that tends to cause mix-ups) in that same area from October 8 to 28, so review plans and double-check details rather than launching something brand new. The retrograde from June 11 to July 4 touches daily routines, which makes it a useful time to tidy your workflow.
aquarius.money: Money tends to be a story of review in the first quarter and of sharing later on. Mercury retrograde from February 10 to March 3 touches your own income, possessions and sense of worth, so it is a sensible time to revisit spending habits and avoid rushed purchases. When Jupiter enters Virgo on July 26, joint finances, debts, shared accounts and support from others come into focus. Clear agreements and open conversations help more than optimism alone. Because Saturn rewards patience, steady habits will likely serve you better than quick moves.
aquarius.growth: With Pluto in your sign, 2027 invites you to look honestly at how you present yourself and what you have outgrown. This is not about reinventing everything at once. It may be a small change in how you speak, dress or set limits. The solar eclipse on February 6 and the lunar eclipse on August 17, both in Aquarius, can bring this theme into sharper view. Eclipses are like strong reset points, and they often show what is ready to change. Saturn in Aries also asks you to slow down in conversation and choose your words. Make room for quiet time, especially near the end of the year when Mars moves through Capricorn from November 26. Rest, reflection and a few habits you can keep will do more for your wellbeing than big resolutions.

pisces.summary: Pisces in 2027 moves from building better daily routines to deepening a key partnership when Jupiter enters Virgo on July 26. Saturn and Neptune keep asking you to rethink money and self-worth.
pisces.overview:
The biggest shift of your year comes from Jupiter, the planet of growth and your traditional ruler. Until July 25 it moves through Leo and lights up your daily work, routines and habits. Think of it as a chance to make everyday life run better: a schedule that suits you, tasks that feel useful, small habits that give you energy. On July 26 Jupiter enters Virgo, your opposite sign, and the focus moves to partnerships and close one-to-one relationships. The second half of the year is more about who you walk beside than what you do each day.

Running underneath all year, Saturn (the planet of structure and limits) and Neptune (the planet of dreams and blur) both sit in Aries, in your area of money, possessions and self-worth. Neptune is also a modern ruler of Pisces, so this matters. Saturn may push you to be more realistic about what you earn, own and deserve, while Neptune can make values and numbers feel foggy. Looking closely at the details, and asking what you truly value, can turn this pairing into something steady rather than confusing.

Two quieter themes complete the picture. Uranus in Gemini keeps stirring home, family and roots, so changes in where or how you live, or in family dynamics, are possible. Pluto in Aquarius works in your private zone of rest, solitude and what happens behind the scenes. Old habits of hiding, over-giving or quietly carrying other people's feelings may come up to be understood and slowly transformed. Time alone is not a luxury this year. It is part of the work.
pisces.love:
Your love life tends to follow the year's two halves. Early on, Mars in Virgo (until February 21, and again from May 15 to July 14) puts partnership in the spotlight, which can bring honest conversations, practical favours and a wish for fairness between two people. Singles may find that connection grows from shared routines, a colleague, a gym, a class, rather than from grand gestures.

From July 26, Jupiter in Virgo makes close relationships the main stage. This is a favourable influence for commitment, deeper trust and meeting someone who balances you. Virgo is your opposite sign, so a partner may seem to have strengths you lack: order, clarity, a grounded eye. Let that be a gift rather than a source of criticism.

Mercury retrograde from June 11 to July 4 touches romance, fun and creativity. It is a better time to revisit old feelings and clear up mixed signals than to rush into something new. Uranus at home may also mean that family matters shape your romantic choices, so make space to talk about them.
pisces.work:
Until July 25, Jupiter in Leo supports your daily work. Skills you practise regularly can be noticed, and offers to take on more useful tasks may arrive. Mars in Leo from February 22 to May 14 adds drive, so spring is a good stretch for reorganising your workload, finishing neglected projects and setting a routine you can keep. Because you are a mutable sign, meaning flexible by nature, you adapt easily, but try to protect your energy by saying no to tasks that are not yours.

The total solar eclipse on August 2 in Leo is a turning point for your work habits. A new way of working, a change of role or a different rhythm could begin to take shape. Give it a few weeks before judging it.

Later, Mars in Sagittarius from October 16 to November 25 turns attention to career, reputation and goals. This is a strong window to speak up about what you want. Mercury retrograde from October 8 to 28 suggests double-checking plans involving study or travel before committing.
pisces.money: Money is a long-term theme, since both Saturn and Neptune move through Aries in your area of income and self-worth. The general tendency is toward slower, more deliberate building, with a need to see clearly what comes in and goes out. Neptune can blur details, so written records and second looks may help you feel grounded. How you value your own time and talent is closely tied to your money story this year. From July 15 to September 1, Mars in Libra brings shared money, such as joint costs or obligations to others, into view and calls for clear agreements.
pisces.growth: Your growth this year lies in balancing generosity with boundaries. Pluto in Aquarius, in your private sector, invites regular solitude, and the eclipses on February 6 and August 17 in Aquarius highlight that need for quiet. Rest is not laziness for you. It is how you sort your own feelings from those you absorb from others. Jupiter in Leo before July encourages simple habits: regular sleep, movement you enjoy, a daily rhythm that steadies your moods. Journaling, music, time near water or creative play can help you process what you feel. In the second half, practise asking for what you need within a relationship, rather than hoping it will be guessed.
